_comment: Static shard lists (E1 design check A11; coordinator choice 13: no assigner), balanced by hand from the per-file times scripts/browser/run.mjs prints. Every spec file is in each list exactly once (scripts/browser-tests.test.mjs). ratchet: seconds per shard; above it the runner warns, above 1.5x it asks for a rebalance; nothing fails on time.
